title: Kagamine Rin — Be Quiet During The Movie!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Even though I already saw it once before, that DVD of RAD WEEKEND was still mind-blowing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. Hearing that Nagi person sing made me want to sing as well!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, An told us a wonderful story.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It really was.
And we got to learn more about Nagi.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's just... I feel really confused now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Confused about what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: About RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An's dad and his team put on this amazing event with that Nagi person at the center of it all...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The atmosphere they created with the other teams was also important...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The same goes for “taking a look at the city”...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Argh! It's just way too much to think about!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? I don't think it's that difficult.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just think of them all as things that need to be done in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that makes it so much easier to understand!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, don't oversimplify it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, we'll just have to take it slow and try to tackle one problem at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take it slow, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case, I want to learn how to feel the air or atmosphere a little better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For example, are things really that different when we're all singing together here versus when a bunch of teams are singing together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course it's different. I mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, hold on...!
Words alone likely won't be able to provide a satisfactory answer.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, Len, mind taking a quick trip with me after this?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A trip?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, a trip? That sounds fun!
I'd like to go too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I assume they're heading over heading over to other side.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's also my guess.
I really hope they don't cause the others too much trouble...
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're here...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Rin, hi.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't forget us!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Including me!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What brings you all here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's something we'd like to ask all of you!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, we'd like you to let us watch a battle in order for us to get more experience feeling what an event's atmosphere is like.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Feeling an event's atmosphere, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We want to learn how to feel the atmosphere at these things better!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If we do that, we'll be able to help you guys out with the next event you put on, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, KAITO suggested that we try to find ways to feel the atmosphere at lots of different events.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If that's the case, you can count on us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Incidentally, we're gonna be in a battle event soon. We'll make sure to let you guys know when it happens!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Um... Will it be just the four of you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I believe so. MEIKO and the others seem to already have a good grasp of this stuff.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! We'll look for a place where we can keep two of our phones hidden so you guys can watch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dropping in to watch is fine and all, but don't let anyone see you, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<We know!
We were fine the other day, no?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! You guys are so awesome!>

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Hm? I thought I just heard someone's voice just now... Coming from over there, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: What? It's all just spare amps and speakers over there. They aren't even plugged in so, there's no way they could've made a sound.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <To be honest, that was a close one...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Shush!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Anyway, we're really looking forward to it!>
